panels.text: The doors open onto a hall of fabrication rings, living blueprints, and builder robots waiting for their next idea.
Your PA lowers a transparent glassworker visor. In the Creation Halls, even an idea is treated like material.
The Chief Builder is a different robot entirely: a specialist leader with a distinct face, tools, parts, and working style.
Request an item, a game, a room, a visual, or a plan. The Hall will begin with a safe prototype.
